fact: MTN Congo said on 13 February 2026 that it had activated the 2Africa cable at Pointe-Noire, giving the country a second international route after the WACS cable, which had been its only international link since 2012; 2Africa has 180 Tbps nominal capacity against 14.5 Tbps for WACS.
title: Congo Expands International Bandwidth with 2Africa Landing
